methodology.roster: Valid 2026 Rhode Island legislative candidates from the declared-candidate workbook used by the project.
methodology.website_audit: Campaign websites were reconciled against the updated candidate website audit workbook supplied on 2026-08-30. Government pages, social profiles, news articles, and generic voter-guide pages were not treated as campaign websites.
methodology.priorities: Existing nonempty candidate priority lists were preserved. For candidates with empty priority lists, conservative paraphrases were added only when substantive positions were stated on a verified official campaign website; no priorities were inferred from party affiliation or biography alone.
methodology.endorsements: Only explicit endorsement statements from an endorsing organization or verified campaign site were included.
methodology.caution: A no-site result means no official campaign website was located during this audit, not that a website definitively does not exist.
